verdict.rationale: Docs clearly cover creating a session, polling for decision/status, webhooks, and passing end-user data (veriff-docs-1, veriff-docs-6, veriff-docs-7, veriff-docs-3), but there's no evidence of API endpoints for retrieving captured media, or for cancelling/redacting a session — review/management is instead shown via the Customer Portal UI (veriff-docs-12, veriff-docs-13), not the API. missing for 10: documented API endpoints for retrieving captured media, and for cancel/redact/delete operations.
